title: Vallée knows more than he can communicate
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Vallée knows more than he can communicate, about 2025 at not stated, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: when I speak to Jacques, I get the sense that, uh, he knows a lot more than he can even communicate with this stuff

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that when he talks with Jacques Vallée, a veteran researcher of UFOs, he gets the sense that Vallée knows a lot more about the subject than he can put into words. Michels said this on his show in 2025, and he also mentions the podcaster Joe Rogan in the same breath. If he is right, one of the field's best-known figures would be holding back knowledge he has no way to share.
